data.one_liner: Detect from where your application was installed like Google Play, App Store, or TestFlight.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that detects the installation source of your application on Android and iOS. It provides futures, widgets, and listeners to retrieve referrer details and package names.
use_when: You need to track acquisition sources or app store origins
You want to display installation metadata inside a Flutter widget
avoid_when: You are targeting unsupported platforms beyond Android and iOS
You require complex mobile attribution beyond simple store detection
strengths: Supports multiple popular Android app stores and iOS platforms
Provides convenient widgets like InstallReferrerDetectorBuilder and InstallReferrerDetectorListener
Easy to integrate with a single Future or widget call
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms
Third-party or non-preinstalled stores on Android default to manual installation values
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package. No complex configuration documented.
